hook: Your boat in Meghalaya looks like it floats in the air.
title: India's River So Clear Boats Seem to Fly
description:
The Umngot river at Dawki, Meghalaya, is so clear that you can see the riverbed through the water. From the right angle, boats look like they are floating in mid-air.

Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.
comment_prompt: Would you ride it? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your boat in Meghalaya looks like it floats in air.
scenes.headline: BOAT IN MID-AIR?

scenes.narration: But that is water under it.
scenes.headline: IT'S ALL WATER

scenes.narration: The Umngot river is that clear.
scenes.headline: THE UMNGOT RIVER

scenes.narration: You can see every stone on the riverbed.
scenes.headline: SEE THE RIVERBED

scenes.narration: The boat's shadow lies on the bottom.
scenes.headline: SHADOW ON THE BED

scenes.narration: Your eyes lose track of the water surface.
scenes.headline: WATER DISAPPEARS

scenes.narration: So the boat seems to hang in the air.
scenes.headline: BOAT SEEMS TO FLY

scenes.narration: Your boat floats in air, and it is water.
scenes.headline: AIR? NO, WATER

scenes.narration: Next: a post office high in the Himalayas.
scenes.headline: NEXT: HIGHEST POST OFFICE
